official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Cartelera turns an idea into a finished video: animate a photo or a painting, make a commercial for your business, a short series, a house tour or a music video with an original song.

What you can do from ChatGPT:
- Start a project from a short description (style, length, vertical or horizontal).
- Follow the plan step by step: Cartelera prepares the script, the scene photos and the music, and you can change any scene or pick a different photo.
- Steps that use your Cartelera tokens (scene photos, music, animated shots) run when you ask for them, and every reply says how many were used. Set a budget for each project and Cartelera never goes past it, nor past the daily limit you chose when you connected.
- Download the finished MP4 when it is ready.
- Make a voice-over from your text in several voices at once, or a new voice described in your words, and edit it (deeper or higher, slower or faster, trim, join, equalize).
- Attach a song or a video and get its music analyzed: whether it is music or speech, the genres it resembles, BPM, key, instruments, mood and the language of the vocals, plus a prompt to create original music in a similar style.

Who it is for: families who want to bring old photos to life, small businesses that need short ads, and creators who want music videos, voice-overs and series in Spanish or English.

Limitations: animating scenes requires a Cartelera account; long videos take a few minutes per scene; Cartelera does not make adult, violent or impersonation content.
